Alternating reciprocal cubes establish strict convexity and the unique minimum; reflection gives the second peak. Ordinary unit cells have normalized Lebesgue growth at most 1, while the two doubled gaps have coefficient at least 4/3, yielding the exact maximum and two-point localization. Integral monotonicity proves strict parity ordering, and beta-integral asymptotics plus B''(0)=3 zeta(3) prove inverse-square and inverse-cube corrections. 244 packaged finite checks reproduce critical identities but do not replace the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Deletion of two measurement sites is a natural robust rational-interpolation problem. The result determines the sharp noise amplification and its worst physical locations, not merely O(log N) order. A striking parity-dependent stabilizing/destabilizing interaction persists for arbitrarily distant fixed gaps, decaying with an exact inverse-square coefficient. These are substantive stability invariants of nonadjacent data loss, rather than a routine increment of the consecutive-block case.
